verdict.rationale: Nothing in the evidence documents official language SDKs or client libraries for the Mollie API, such as server-side packages for PHP, Node, or Python. Mollie JS is only an embeddable card-field component library. The Magento and Shopify modules are prebuilt platform plugins, not SDKs to build against. The other items cover REST APIs, the MCP server and llms.txt, which do not evidence SDKs, and no OpenAPI spec was found to generate one.
